target.title: feat(cli): add roast taglines to startup banner
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Follow-up to #102750: the refreshed CLI tagline pool leans affectionate; the community's roast culture (personality bots, /roastme, agents keeping receipts on their humans) had no representation in the rotation.

## Why This Change Was Made

Appends 10 roast-flavored taglines to the rotating pool in `src/cli/tagline.ts`. They target universal developer behavior (tab hoarding, ancient TODOs, force-push denial, unread error messages, quota burn) rather than anything personal, keeping them banner-safe. CLI pool only: the installer pool intentionally stays roast-free since first-run users have no relationship with the agent yet. Selection logic, holiday gating, and the installer are untouched.

## User Impact

The `openclaw` startup banner occasionally roasts you now. Users who prefer neutrality already have `cli.banner.taglineMode: "default"` or `"off"`.

## Evidence

- `oxfmt --check` and `oxlint` clean on `src/cli/tagline.ts`; diff is +10 string literals, nothing else.
- Pool math: 105 rotating + 10 holiday = 115 entries, still under the 200-sample pool-recovery sweep in `tagline.test.ts`; the `OPENCLAW_TAGLINE_INDEX=0` pin resolves to the same first entry (additions appended before holiday refs).
- Codex autoreview (gpt-5.5) on the diff: clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
- Exact-head hosted CI enforced by the `OPENCLAW_TESTBOX=1` prepare gate before merge.
